data.why: The app has no file-upload widget, only a text area to paste a FASTA or raw sequence, so these files hold ready-made sequences (a normal protein, a too-short peptide, invalid amino-acid codes, and a DNA sequence) for the browser agent to paste in and exercise the validation and analysis paths.

goals: Paste a protein sequence and get its molecular weight, isoelectric point, instability index, aromaticity, and GRAVY score
View the amino acid composition (counts and percentages) of the protein
Predict secondary-structure fractions (alpha helix, beta turn, beta sheet) for the sequence
Assess hydrophobic vs hydrophilic residue distribution
Estimate the molar extinction coefficient (reduced and oxidized) and disulfide bond potential
Export the full analysis as CSV, Excel, JSON, or a PDF report

review.summary: The tree says exactly what the analyzer is for, its stages are real, and every screen I sampled shows what its node claims except the JSON-download citation. It needs small fixes before filing: add two validation branches, record the second-click quirk, recut f4/f7 and tighten a few labels.
